modelNative.note: Stored model/native score gaps usually compare different champion patches and objectives; these are not measured surrogate errors.

comparison.note: These are different named scans using the same configuration and metric; a lower current cell does not indicate regression or deletion in the old scan.

throughput.basis: Existing live runner log; recent complete checkpoints from last hour, first checkpoint excluded from numerator because preceding start time unavailable.

recovery.note: Freshly remeasured candidate recovery against the captured snapshot; no live results were overwritten during this review.

publicationAudit.scope: Current configured worker/session credential values; common private-key, GitHub credential, and credential-header patterns; private runtime/config path patterns.
limitations: Matched currently configured credential values and common high-confidence private-key/GitHub/header patterns. This is not an exhaustive external secret-scanner audit.
Live export and summary are sequential GETs while the runner continues; counters may be slightly newer than exported champions.
Visits count focused search passes, evaluations mix model proposal and per-target model analyses, and captures are three-note native renders. They are different work units.
Only active scan was exported; inactive scan results were not switched or modified.
